summary: Tested CricTrack backend (10/10 pytest passing) and frontend E2E on mobile viewport. Discovered and fixed 1 critical backend bug: unique-sparse email index blocked 2nd phone-only signup. Frontend flows verified end-to-end: login -> OTP -> profile setup -> matches tab -> team creation (x2) -> match creation -> live scoring (4/6/1/wicket/undo) -> innings switch -> match completed -> tournament creation & detail. No deprecated Expo packages detected. testIDs present on all interactive elements.

critical.issue: FIXED: Unique+sparse index on 'email' rejected phone signups after the first because User model inserts email:null (sparse only ignores absent fields, not null values). Replaced with partialFilterExpression {email: {$type:'string'}}. server.py:517-524.

action_items: None critical. Optional cleanup: existing DBs may still have the old email_1 index; server.py now drops it on startup, but confirm on fresh deploys the partialFilterExpression index is used.

Minor UX: On tournament detail 'Teams' tab, the query selector [data-testid^='add-'] also matches 'add-match-btn' and 'add-team-tournament-btn'. Not a bug; tests should use exact prefixes 'add-<team_id>' when clicking team-add buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auth: sparse unique index on nullable field was a footgun (now fixed to partialFilterExpression).
server.py has no ObjectId leak (all reads use projection {_id:0}).
MatchComplete auto-picks winner correctly by comparing innings runs; handles tie -> null winner.
NRR calculation correctly caps balls at overs*6 when all-out (10 wickets).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (login, otp, profile, teams, match, scoring, tournament creation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -o addopts=''` (project pytest.ini enables xdist which causes duplicate module-scoped fixtures; override addopts when running). Frontend E2E script logic in this iteration was reliable; use direct URLs (/teams/create, /matches/create, /tournaments/create) to bypass tab-nav flakiness. Only real bug found (email unique index) is already fixed and validated.
rca_of_issue: RCA: startup created `db.users.create_index('email', unique=True, sparse=True)`. Sparse unique means duplicate nulls are OK ONLY if the field is missing; when the field is present with value null (as happens for phone signups where Pydantic serializes Optional[str]=None to null), the second insert triggers E11000 duplicate key on {email:null}. Repro: sign up two different phone numbers -> 2nd returns 500. Fix: drop old index, create partial index with partialFilterExpression={'email':{'$type':'string'}} so only real string emails participate. Validated by 10/10 pytest + E2E flow creating fresh phone user successfully.
